lockPurpose: Identify the exact OEWN edition/artifact evaluated for Dictionary Ecosystem v2 qualification. This is not production registration or Official-pack approval.

source.publisher: Open English WordNet Community / Global Wordnet Association

release.edition: 2025 standard edition, excluding the separate 2025 Plus proper-name selection and the full Open English Namenet resource

artifact.artifactIdentityMethod: Versioned official filename and project download page, paired with exact Git tag commit plus locally observed size and SHA-256. The archive itself is not signed and the project does not publish a checksum on the download page.

role.intendedRole: English monolingual semantic/sense supplement; English lemmas, POS, senses, pronunciations and lexical relations.
role.notApprovedRole: English-to-Chinese bilingual source or replacement for the existing EN-to-zh-CN Core

licenseAndProvenance.upstreamLicenseStatement: The exact tag's LICENSE.md states that the resource derives from Princeton WordNet under the WordNet License and OEWN's further development is CC BY 4.0.
licenseAndProvenance.oewnLicense: CC BY 4.0 for Open English WordNet contributions
licenseAndProvenance.underlyingLicense: Princeton WordNet 3.0 License continues to apply to underlying WordNet material; preserve its notice and disclaimer in WNDB_License.txt.
licenseAndProvenance.provenance: OEWN project describes the 2025 release as its community-developed English lexical network derived from Princeton WordNet; the 2025 release transfers the prior proper-name inventory to Open English Namenet and offers a separate curated Plus edition.
licenseAndProvenance.attributionAndModificationRequirements: Retain attribution to Princeton WordNet and the Open English WordNet team, preserve the WordNet notice/disclaimer, link CC BY 4.0, and mark modifications. Do not imply endorsement.
licenseAndProvenance.redistributionGate: source terms are published for the exact project revision; any distributable derivative must carry both the underlying WordNet notice and OEWN attribution/license obligations. No Official trust-root qualification is established.
licenseAndProvenance.repositoryLicenseEvidence: Exact 2025-edition LICENSE.md and WNDB_License.txt, not the extension's license.

minimumImporterCapabilities: bounded ZIP extraction or streaming access to 73 JSON members
